verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an official Mac desktop app with a global OS-level keyboard shortcut (Option+Space) to summon Gemini without opening a browser [gemini-docs-15, gemini-docs-36, gemini-docs-20], but the only 'see what's on your screen' capability documented is for the Android mobile app via 'Hey Google' [gemini-docs-6], not the desktop app. Missing for 10: evidence of desktop screen-reading/screenshare capability, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the desktop shortcut and screen access working together.
